Both images are published by .github/workflows/docker.yml on every push
to main, and built locally by interop/moq-runner/build_image.sh. The
relay answers raw QUIC and WebTransport on one port, so it registers an
endpoint for each: moqt://-only clients (moqtopus, xquic) need the first.

quic-zig.name: quic-zig
quic-zig.notes: QUIC, HTTP/3, WebTransport and MoQ from scratch in Zig. The relay serves raw QUIC and WebTransport on one port, chosen by ALPN; the client speaks both transports and selects its draft with --draft.
